name: legal-style installment loan
text:
LOAN AGREEMENT
1. Definitions
The loan principal is $18,000 (the "Principal").
2. Repayment
APR: 9.9%.
Term: 36 months.
Monthly EMI: $579.96.
3. Fees
Documentation fee: 4% of the Principal, deducted from loan proceeds.
Late charge: 8% of each installment after 5 days overdue.
4. Default and remedies
Any payment default is a default under this agreement.
A default under another agreement is a cross-default.
Upon default, the lender may accelerate the entire balance and make all amounts immediately due.
Upon default, the lender may repossess collateral without prior notice.
5. Changes
The lender may, in its sole discretion, increase the APR or change other terms.
6. Disputes and collateral
The borrower waives the right to a jury trial and to participate in a class action.
All disputes must be resolved by binding arbitration.
The security interest extends to after-acquired property.
